name: seo-supervisor
description: SEO for AI coding agents: audit, safe fixes, PR review, a launch gate, setup from scratch, content briefs, plain-words rewrites, growth plans, watching what changed, and connecting your data. Crawls any site, scores it 0-100 and writes a polished offline report.

scripts.demo: node skills/seo-supervisor/scripts/render-report.mjs skills/seo-supervisor/examples/sample-audit.json --out docs/index.html --no-md && node skills/seo-supervisor/scripts/render-report.mjs skills/seo-supervisor/examples/sample-audit.json --out skills/seo-supervisor/examples/sample-report.html && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('skills/seo-supervisor/examples/drafts', 'docs/drafts', { recursive: true })"

author: Zaman Khan
